messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Allah mun tuba gamu gareka ka jikanmu ka tausaya mana badan halin mu ba kadubemu da rahama taka ka karemu da dukkan alumar annabi Don albarka sa ka tausaya mana mun tuba😭😭😭😭.

output.original_text: Allah mun tuba gamu gareka ka jikanmu ka tausaya mana badan halin mu ba kadubemu da rahama taka ka karemu da dukkan alumar annabi Don albarka sa ka tausaya mana mun tuba😭😭😭😭.
output.joy: Allah mun tuba gamu gareka ka jikanmu ka tausaya mana cikin farin ciki, ka ba mu kyautar rahama ta ba kadubemu, ka kare mu da dukkan alumar annabi Don albarka, mun tuba!
output.sadness: Allah mun tuba gamu gareka, ka jikanmu, ka tausaya mana a wannan halin murnar mu ba kadubemu, ka kare mu da rahama, mun tuba da zuciya mai nauyi.
output.fear: Allah mun tuba gamu gareka, ka jikanmu, muna jin tsoro kan halin mu, ka tausaya mana, ka kare mu da dukkan alumar annabi, mun tuba.
output.anger: Allah mun tuba gareka, ka jikanmu, ka tausaya mana, me yasa halin mu ya zamto haka? Kada mu kada mu daga rahama, ka kare mu da dukkan alumar annabi, mun tuba!
output.surprise: Allah mun tuba, haka ku mun tuba gareka, ka jikanmu, ka tausaya mana, ba mu tsammani halin mu zai zama haka, ka kare mu da dukkan alumar annabi, mun tuba!
output.disgust: Allah mun tuba, irinsa halin da muka shiga ba abin da ya dace ba, ka jikanmu, ka tausaya mana, kada mu kada mu da wahala, ka kare mu da dukkan alumar annabi, mun tuba.
